settings.question: How can I judge the scale?
settings.answer: Use the published dimensions and in-room gallery image. Contact our team if you want a second opinion before ordering.

settings.question: Will every piece look exactly the same?
settings.answer: Any natural variation should be stated in the product details. Product photography is color-accurate, but screens and handmade finishes can vary.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: The current estimate appears beside Add to Cart. Final timing depends on destination and any stated maker lead time.

settings.question: What if it arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact our team with clear photos of the item and packaging. We will explain the fastest replacement or refund route.
